name: Sunken Festival Street
introDiscord:
A street beyond the palace is frozen in the remains of a festival.

Lantern strings cross overhead.

Game booths line the road.

Masks hang from stalls.

Paper stars drift through the current.

For once, the kingdom doesn't feel abandoned.

It feels like everyone simply stepped away for a moment.

the-council-in-silence-approach.prompt: Sunken Festival Street opens into three routes through the drowned kingdom.

left.message: A masked Revenant rises from behind an old festival stall.

right.message:
One Berry rests beneath Shizuki's festival scorecard:

'RING TOSS:

Shizuki — 2
Glimmer — 9

GLIMMER CAN FLY CLOSER TO TARGET.

DISQUALIFIED.'

forward.message: A prize booth still contains Star Candies.

the-council-in-silence-depths.prompt: Deeper within Sunken Festival Street, three paths wind through the abandoned royal district.

left.message: A festival refreshment stand contains restorative drinks.
left.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

right.message: A masked Revenant blocks the lantern street.

forward.message: A game booth contains sealed prize Star Candies.

the-council-in-silence-threshold.prompt: Near Festival Lantern Stage, three final approaches lead onward.

left.message: A mask seller's chest contains Star Candies and paper crowns.

right.message:
Shizuki's restorative bottle:

'Festival recovery.

Used after attempting every game in one afternoon.

No regrets.'
right.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

forward.message: A final masked guardian waits beneath the lantern arch.

bossPromptDiscord:
Every festival lantern suddenly lights.

Music begins from instruments with no musicians.

At the end of the street, one elaborate masked figure raises a
ceremonial baton.

Use /yes to enter the final festival game or /no to leave
before Glimmer finds another unfair competition.

bossRetreatText: You withdraw from Festival Lantern Stage. The royal challenge will wait.

boss.revealText: The Festival Master Revenant reveals itself!

completionText:
The music fades.

The lanterns remain glowing.

Shizuki's final scorecard says:

'Festival Street:

★★★★★

Glimmer still disqualified.'
